notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The shaft runs along +Y here, because the file is exported with xrot(-90) from the part's own +Z frame. The previous render is the clone-gated recreation (render.json says why it is not dist-gated), with the shared bevel crown standing in for the reference's own tooth form and the Ø0.2 wall holes left out. The revised one draws the print fits listed in 720-001_DiffGearShaft.scad's header: the press clearance on the journals and seats, the shoulders turned to the bearings' inner races, the shorter front end and the collar behind the band turned down to the band's root. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
